title: Floodmark Gate
description: A Romanesque limestone gate with three concentric orders, battered ashlar piers and a paved ford threshold.

review.notes: Round 2 (weathering only). The sheet was re-rendered: source and sheet hashes are new and vr.py check passes. But the weathering does not read: compared with the round-1 sheet, the turn tiles differ by under 1 grey level on average and closeup_base by about 3 (sips/BMP pixel diff), and at full size the gate still looks one clean, even ivory (hero, closeup_upper, closeup_base). The rain, foot-damp and tread masks multiply tints into only part of a 0-0.6/0.7 ramp under a noise threshold, so almost nothing survives. Fix: make the effects visible at review distance: rain streaks under the impost mouldings and the crown about 20-30% darker in a clear vertical pattern; a green-grey damp band about 1-2 m high at the pier feet with lichen spots; visibly darker, smoother worn tread in the middle of the threshold. Geometry stays as approved-level (8 on form).
